parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Mission · Cardinal Street and the northwest
Steelhead is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Mission doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City’s Rural Mission Strategy page names Steelhead among the rural communities it covers.
On this site, listings tagged Steelhead are on Cardinal Street, Campbell Street, Sabo Street and Silverdale Avenue.
My working description, not an official boundary: the rural area in the northwest of the city around Cardinal Street.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 18, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Mission and Mission Public Schools (School District 75).
General information only.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations, flood rules and school catchments before you buy or sell.

Planning, zoning and flood

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Steelhead

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

Bylaw 6405-2026, the Official Community Plan, was adopted by the City on June 1, 2026, and it repeals and replaces Bylaw 6350-2025. According to the City’s public notice, the two are substantively the same plan.
The City’s Rural Mission Strategy was approved by Council on December 1, 2025, and names Steelhead.
I found no neighbourhood or area plan specific to Steelhead on the City pages I read.
A City notice covers rezoning 33420, 33440 and 33452 Cardinal Street from Rural 36 (RU36) to Rural 16 (RU16) to allow a 13-lot subdivision with a minimum lot size of 1.6 hectares (4 acres).

The City’s storm update records flooding on Cardinal Street in Steelhead: the street was closed because of flooding, and visitors stranded in Steelhead were taken out by boat by Mission Search and Rescue.
I found no City page that gives a floodplain designation for specific Steelhead properties.

Mission has 1,539 hectares of Agricultural Land Reserve, according to the BC Government’s Land Use Inventory of the District of Mission (2011). That works out to roughly seven percent of the District’s land area.
Steelhead is not the name of any route on BC Transit’s Central Fraser Valley route list, and no Mission route (31, 32, 33, 34, 35 or 39) uses the name either.
For a specific lot, send me the address and I’ll look up the zone and the plan designation.

Check the road and access.

Where is Steelhead?
Steelhead is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Mission doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City’s Rural Mission Strategy page names Steelhead among the rural communities it covers.
How do I get around from Steelhead?
BC Transit lists no route named for Steelhead in its Central Fraser Valley route list. Not even the Mission routes, which are 31, 32, 33, 34, 35 and 39, are named for it.
The nearest West Coast Express station is Mission City Station, at 33200 North Railway Avenue in Mission.
Which schools are near Steelhead?
I found no public school in Steelhead. Stave Falls Elementary, Kindergarten to 6, is at 30204 Brackley Ave.

The senior secondary school that the Province lists for the district is École Mission Senior Secondary, 32939 7th Avenue, for Grades 10 to 12. A school with 1,500 seats is due to replace it at that location, and Infrastructure BC has the project listed as under construction.
Catchments are set by address, so confirm a specific address with
Mission Public Schools (School District 75)
, which publishes a catchment map.
What is there to do in Steelhead?
The City’s Notice of Permissive Tax Exemptions lists the Steelhead Community Association at 32972 Cardinal Street for “Recreational facilities and programs”.

The City says its roughly 10,900-hectare Municipal Forest (Mission Tree Farm Licence #26) takes in the forested landscapes of Bear Mountain, Red Mountain and Steelhead, and has been managed by the City’s Forestry Department since 1958.
What plan covers Steelhead?
The City’s Official Community Plan Bylaw 6405-2026 was adopted June 1, 2026, repealing and replacing Bylaw 6350-2025. The City’s public notice describes the earlier plan as substantively the same.
The City’s Rural Mission Strategy page names Steelhead among the rural communities it covers.
Is Steelhead in a floodplain?

The City’s storm update records flooding on Cardinal Street in Steelhead: the street was closed because of flooding, and visitors stranded in Steelhead were taken out by boat by Mission Search and Rescue.
I found no City page that gives a floodplain designation for specific Steelhead properties.
Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
